title: RDK-B Core Broadband Flash Layout by Partition
description: Per-profile logical flash partition breakdown, answering 'what consumes the flash minimum'. Sibling file to memory-footprint.schema.json, kept separate from hw-compat.schema.json so layout can be refined as real bring-up data comes in without touching the CPU/RAM/flash/peripheral spec file. Partition classes only — exact byte offsets and OEM-specific bootloader/calibration layout are out of scope (see Hardware Compatibility Specification Section 3.3).

specVersion.description: Version of this JSON schema (semantic version), e.g. "1.0".

profileId.description: Matches the profileId in the corresponding hw-compat.schema.json file for this profile.

measured.description: True if partition sizes below are measured from an actual built image; false if sizes are architectural estimates/proposals pending real bring-up measurement.

referenceDevice.description: Optional. Device the layout was measured or proposed against, e.g. "BPI-R4 (MediaTek MT7988, Filogic)".

lastMeasured.description: Optional. ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent measurement or estimate revision.

totalFlashMB.description: Optional. Total flash in MB this layout is sized against; should be >= the profile's storage.minFlashMB in hw-compat.

partitions.description: Logical partition classes, in typical flash-offset order. Empty when measured is false and no estimate has been proposed yet.

purpose.description: What this partition holds and why it's required.

sizeMB.description: Size in MB, or "TBD" if not yet sized.

requiredForOTA.description: Optional. True if this partition class is required to support A/B OTA firmware upgrade.

owner.description: Optional. Who defines/writes the content of this partition — Core RDK-B, the OEM, or the SoC/component vendor.

notes.description: Optional. Free-text notes, e.g. explaining estimate basis or why a profile's layout is unmeasured.
